definitions.explanation: The detection and identification of a disease or condition at an early stage, before it has progressed significantly.

examples.japanese: {早期診断|そうきしんだん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{大切|たいせつ}→大切：01456_taisetsu⟧だ。
がん⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{早期診断|そうきしんだん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{命|いのち}→命：02371_inochi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{助|たす}かった→助かる：01956_tasukaru⟧。
examples.english: Early diagnosis of cancer saved a life.

examples.japanese: ⟦{定期的|ていきてき}→定期的：06173_teikiteki⟧な⟦{健康診断|けんこうしんだん}→健康診断：05979_kenkoushindan⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{早期診断|そうきしんだん}・{早期治療|そうきちりょう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧つながる。
examples.english: Regular health checkups lead to early diagnosis and early treatment.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{早期|そうき}→早期：09568_souki⟧ (early stage) + ⟦{診断|しんだん}→診断：04209_shindan⟧ (diagnosis). Often paired with {早期治療|そうきちりょう} (early treatment) in the set phrase {早期診断|そうきしんだん}・{早期治療|そうきちりょう}, which is a cornerstone principle of Japanese preventive medicine.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {早期診断|そうきしんだん}・{早期治療|そうきちりょう}: early diagnosis and early treatment
- {早期診断|そうきしんだん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{重要性|じゅうようせい}→重要性：04823_juuyousei⟧: importance of early diagnosis
- がん⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{早期診断|そうきしんだん}: early diagnosis of cancer

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{早期発見|そうきはっけん}→早期発見：16127_soukihakken⟧: early detection — finding a condition early, often used interchangeably
- ⟦{健康診断|けんこうしんだん}→健康診断：05979_kenkoushindan⟧: health checkup — the examination that enables early diagnosis
- ⟦{人間ドック|にんげんどっく}→人間ドック：23310_ningendokku⟧: comprehensive medical checkup — a thorough examination popular in Japan
